cards.title: Puls's judge
cards.text: A model asked whether an answer is a meal for the people asked for.

cards.title: Its rubric
cards.text: Read from the cook's eval folder, with the people and the town.

cards.title: On the harness's judge
cards.text: In its own project, so the identity never references the harness.

cards.title: Only the runner
cards.text: No host carries the harness. Only the eval runner references it.
